basic_profile.bio: A mechanical engineer by profession, BattleBotGuru88 hails from San Francisco, California. Passionate about robotics and combat sports, they have been an avid follower of BattleBots since its inception. When not discussing the latest bot battles, they enjoy hiking the trails of Marin County and tinkering with DIY projects in their garage. Generally online during the evenings Pacific Time, they balance their time between work, a close-knit group of friends, and their cat named Gizmo. Single and enjoying it, they find fulfillment in their hobbies and career.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering from UC Berkeley, BattleBotGuru88 has been involved in several robotics projects and competitions. Their knowledge is further enhanced by years of self-study and active participation in online forums dedicated to robotics and technology.
